title: Passage 40
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Confucianism has been followed by Chinese people for more than 2,000 years, and it has influenced Chinese culture throughout this era.
sentences.cn: 中国人奉行儒家思想已有两千多年了，在这期间，它一直影响着中国文化。

sentences.en: In modern socialism, Confucian values continue to guide how we treat others.
sentences.cn: 在现代社会主义中，儒家价值观继续指导着我们如何待人。

sentences.en: Confucianism teaches Ren, Yi, Li, Ji and Xin, which are general virtues around the world.
sentences.cn: 儒家思想教导“仁、义、礼、智、信”，这些都是全世界普遍（推崇）的美德。

sentences.en: According to Confucius, a wise and respected teacher,
sentences.cn: 在孔子这位充满智慧、备受尊敬的老师看来，

sentences.en: Ren is the feeling of care and love we should have for others.
sentences.cn: “仁”就是我们对他人应怀有的关爱之情。

sentences.en: It can be as simple as giving care to a neighbour who has a fever,
sentences.cn: 这可以是像照顾一位发烧的邻居这样简单的事，

sentences.en: but it promotes friendship and harmony so that some wars may be avoided.
sentences.cn: 但它能增进友谊与和谐，从而可能避免一些战争。

sentences.en: Confucius said, "What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others."
sentences.cn: 孔子说过：“己所不欲，勿施于人。”

sentences.en: It is quite similar to the golden rule in western countries, which encourages people to be friendly.
sentences.cn: 这与西方国家的“金规则”十分相似，它鼓励人们友善待人。

sentences.en: The meaning of Yi is a little harder to express.
sentences.cn: “义”的含义有点难表达。

sentences.en: It can be thought of as duty or even respect.
sentences.cn: 它可以被理解为责任，甚至是尊重。

sentences.en: While Ren is mostly about our opinions and feelings, Yi is about how we should act.
sentences.cn: “仁”大多关乎我们的观点和感受，而“义”则关乎我们的行为举止。

sentences.en: Generally, Yi is the way we should connect with people.
sentences.cn: 通常，“义”是我们与人交往应有的方式。

sentences.en: For example, we say polite words such as pardon or excuse me to show our respect.
sentences.cn: 例如，我们会说“抱歉”或“请原谅我”等礼貌用语来表示尊重。

sentences.en: In Confucian writings, discussions about Yi also include how to remember ancestors.
sentences.cn: 在儒家著作中，关于“义”的讨论还包括如何缅怀祖先。

sentences.en: Xin emphasises that one should be honest in relationships.
sentences.cn: “信”则强调在人际关系中要诚实。

sentences.en: This means we shouldn't ever lie or cheat.
sentences.cn: 这意味着我们不应该撒谎或欺骗。

sentences.en: In this way, we can build strong and lasting relationships with others.
sentences.cn: 这样我们才能和他人建立起牢固而长久的关系。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most well-known Confucian virtue is Xiao.
sentences.cn: 也许最广为人知的儒家美德是“孝”。

sentences.en: Xiao means loving, respecting, obeying and taking care of one's parents, as well as grandfather and grandmother.
sentences.cn: “孝”意味着爱戴、敬重、遵从和照顾父母以及祖父、祖母。

sentences.en: Xiao is important for a harmonious society.
sentences.cn: “孝”对和谐社会很重要。

sentences.en: Without it, the whole world would fall into a mess.
sentences.cn: 没有“孝”，整个世界将陷入混乱。
